name: app-shater-professional-verification-screens-grid
title: Shater craftsman professional-data verification: profession, skills, languages and document-upload screens
whatItIs: A grid of ten phone screens covering professional data entry (profession, skills, years of experience, spoken languages with pill chips), messaging and notifications, and a document-upload form for national ID front/back and a criminal record certificate before final submission.
whatItMeans: Thorough and trustworthy; requiring real documents before activation shows the platform vets craftsmen seriously.
techniques: Collect structured professional data as pill-chip selections.
Require document uploads before granting full access.
Pair form screens with the messaging and alerts they lead to.

vocabulary.definition: Checking a person's credentials before approval.
Choosing multiple options shown as rounded tags.
